name: Shanghai Electric Power Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Electric Power Co., Ltd. engages in the integration of clean energy, new energy, smart energy technology research and development and application, modern energy supply, and services in China and internationally. It is involved in photovoltaic, wind, gas electric, and thermal power generation and heating; thermal electricity generation; trading of electricity; research and development; technology development; and investment management activities. The company also provides electrical power consulting and power technical services; power supply and engineering construction services; and technology promotion and application services.
